keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
First Half ends, Chelsea 0, Manchester United 0.
Goal! Chelsea 1, Manchester United 0. Morgan Rogers (Chelsea) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Roméo Lavia.
Substitution, Manchester United. Kobbie Mainoo replaces Carlos Baleba.
Lisandro Martínez (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Lisandro Martínez (Manchester United) for a bad foul.
Goal! Chelsea 2, Manchester United 0. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Manchester United. Mason Mount replaces Matheus Cunha.
Substitution, Manchester United. Ayden Heaven replaces Andrey Santos.
Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chelsea. Pep Chavarría replaces Marco Palestra.
Delay in match because of an injury Amad Diallo (Manchester United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Manchester United. Joshua Zirkzee replaces Amad Diallo because of an injury.
Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card.
Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chelsea. Danny Welbeck replaces Moisés Caicedo.
Substitution, Chelsea. Valentín Barco replaces Pedro Neto.
Substitution, Chelsea. Malo Gusto replaces Estêvão.
Mike Penders (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Chelsea. Geovany Quenda replaces Cole Palmer.
Second Half ends, Chelsea 2, Manchester United 0.
